seo.title: A Day & Night at Boulders · Wolwedans
seo.description: Sunrise drives, Bushman walks, sundowners on the granite and a naked-eye star safari. One day at Boulders Camp, hour by hour.

hero.title: A Day & Night at Boulders
hero.subtitle: Everything here is included, except time. That you bring yourself.

image.alt: Overhead view of the camp, its stone-circle paths and the fire pit

intro: Days at Boulders follow the light. Early starts while the air is cool, long quiet afternoons, and evenings that end far from any city glow.
